shared_or_similar_visual_information: A fill selecting one side of a visible geometric or plotted boundary. On the left, use the gray side of the rising dashed line that contains the origin. On the right, use the light-blue ring between the two concentric circles.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It marks the open half-plane of coordinate pairs satisfying the strict linear inequality. Right image: It is the part of the disk of radius 7 outside the disk of radius 5.
Rationales: The shaded half-plane records which coordinate pairs meet an inequality. The geometric fill delimits a measured area after removing the depicted cutout or excluded portion.
